blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines —˜The Marcos administration has raised P167.25 billion in new money from its 32nd retail Treasury bond (RTB) offering, exceeding its P150-billion target after a weeklong offer period. Initially, the Bureau of the Treasury (BTr) set a P30-billion target in its notice of offering before raising it to P150 billion during the launch. READ: […]...
